none: PAS NLM-291443: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), cf. RIC volume 5 part 2 no. 132, Reece period 13. A possible mule: the obverse appears a regular portrait but the reverse may be a made with a barbarous die. Obverse description: Beardless radiate bust draped right. Obverse inscription: C[-]TETRICVS CAES. Reverse description: Blundered stick figure representing female standing left with right arm extended and lifting skirt. Reverse inscription: reversed S in right field [?SPES AVGG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.87gms, die axis: 12
